question: 10. Does ____________ respond when you call his/her name?

ask_yes_followup.text: Please give me an example of how he/she responds when you call his/her name. (If parent does not give a 0 example below, ask each individually.)

ask_no_followup.text: If he/she is not involved in something fun or interesting, what does he/she do when you call his/her name? (If parent does not give a 0 example below, ask each individually.)

items: Seem to hear but ignores parent?
Respond only if parent is right in front of the child's face?

clarify_frequency.text: Which one does he/she do most often?
